intro.headline: How the Town of Addison reclaimed 800+ staff hours, drafted dozens of reports, and built a blueprint for 5x ROI.
paragraphs: Addison's Executive Director of Internal Services, Hamid Khaleghipour, oversees key administrative operations, working to make Town services faster, simpler, and more efficient for residents and staff.

Hamid recognized that valuable staff capacity was being drained by manual document retrieval and research. Driven by a vision to empower municipal employees with modern, high-precision tools, he sought out Madison AI's partnership to centralize institutional knowledge across Town departments.

photo.alt: Hamid Khaleghipour, Addison's Executive Director of Internal Services

props.title: Addison's Search for a Solution
paragraphs: Serving a residential population of approximately 16,000 people, the Town of Addison relies on a dedicated staff of roughly 350 employees. Decades of municipal governance, council records, financial audits, zoning codes, and contracts had become scattered across legacy file systems and PDF archives. Before turning to Madison AI, researching council actions or verifying municipal codes required hours of sifting through databases.

Hamid was in search of an AI ecosystem that would operate securely within the bounds of Addison's approved, official public records. By selecting Madison AI, Addison secured a purpose-built platform trained exclusively on its own verified data, ensuring outputs are accurate and fully cited.

props.title: Hands-On Training, Instant Results
paragraphs: Addison employees learned to leverage Madison AI agents for a range of tasks in interactive, on-site trainings hosted by Madison AI. From pulling precise contract terms to drafting council-ready staff reports, staff can now execute research tasks in seconds, gaining valuable time back in their day.

quote.text: By providing access to prior discussions and projects, Madison AI helps staff quickly gather background information and executive policies on the items they're working on. This has resulted in significant time savings and lots of positive feedback.
quote.attribution: Hamid Khaleghipour, Executive Director of Internal Services, Town of Addison

props.title: Scattered municipal records
props.intro: Navigating decades of scattered data led to daily operational delays, diverting staff from direct community engagement. Some of the Town's most pressing challenges were:

items.title: Hidden Records
items.description: Decades of council decisions, policy histories, and municipal agreements were often difficult to locate in databases.

items.title: Manual Research Delays
items.description: Preparing council packets, researching permit histories, and verifying municipal codes required hours of tedious document hunting.

items.title: Strain on Staff
items.description: Department heads and staff spent a large portion of their workweek on manual research rather than strategic community initiatives.

phases.title: Identifying Operational Friction
phases.description: Leadership identified numerous high-friction tasks, including council packet preparation, contract analysis, and historical ordinance lookups, as the primary activities for AI automation.

phases.title: Model Deployment
phases.description: Madison AI implemented several assistants tailored to Addison's organizational structure, equipping employees with specialized agents capable of handling administration, financial analysis, and planning research.

phases.title: Data Integrity and Security
phases.description: The platform was built strictly around Addison's database of council records, municipal codes, budgets, and administrative policies.

phases.title: Collaboration and Staff Adoption
phases.description: Through on-site training sessions with Madison AI team members, the Town of Addison achieved a 37%+ adoption rate among non-public-safety staff.

phases.title: Expanding Workflow
phases.description: As staff gained confidence in the system, Addison adopted additional agents, including a Human Resources model and a custom assistant for Addison Airport.

props.title: The Impact: Reclaiming 867 Staff Hours
paragraphs: The Town of Addison's partnership with Madison AI has transformed how municipal staff access institutional knowledge and perform daily tasks. Staff can now instantly access accurate historical data, contract terms, and code citations, resulting in operational efficiency that allows them to better serve their community.

Addison has demonstrated that with the right tools, public agencies can harness artificial intelligence to empower staff and maximize public value, further increasing the quality of life for all residents, businesses, and visitors in Addison.
